version.description: The Groundwork version that installed or last upgraded this project's .groundwork/ files. Written by `groundwork init` and `groundwork upgrade`; `groundwork doctor` compares it with the CLI.

flow.description: Whether the optional development flow is installed on top of project memory. Only `groundwork flow on` and `groundwork flow off` change it.

tokenBudget.description: Maximum estimated tokens for files loaded in every session (AGENTS.md plus always-on adapter files). Checked by `groundwork doctor`.

budgets.description: Maximum estimated tokens (about 4 characters each) per memory file, checked by `groundwork doctor`; `groundwork compact` brings the journal, decisions and handoff back under them. brief is the size of what `groundwork brief` prints and a session start loads.

staleAfterDays.description: A handoff older than this many days is reported as stale, whatever git says.

nudge.description: Whether the stop hook asks the agent, once per commit, to save a handoff that is behind the repository. false: hooks still record the journal, and never speak.
